d: In the season one finale, it's all hands on deck as Ted and his team have to clear out The National. But all work and no play is not how they roll...
In the series premiere, the salvage team at family-owned Priestly Demolition recovers historic treasures from buildings that have reached the end of their lives.

Series following colourful life in a large pawn shop. From alligators to false limbs, its staff has no idea what could come through the door next.
